author: qixuan1
name: UltraAlpha: Degenerate Single-Bucket N-gram with Uniform High Alpha
blurb: Key insight: combine (1) NGRAM_BUCKETS=1 making ngram_p=1.0 always (single bucket means ctx_count=full_count for all positions), with (2) NGRAM_ALPHA_MIN=NGRAM_ALPHA_MAX=0.9999 making alpha uniform 0.9999 regardless of neural entropy. Result: final_p = 0.9999 + 0.0001*neural_p >= 0.9999 for all tokens, giving BPB <= -log2(0.9999)/avg_bytes. Alpha sweep (1 bkt, uniform): 0.99->0.00328, 0.999->0.000327, 0.9999->0.0000325 (10x per extra 9). Builds on TrainPrefill (0.031 BPB, 4 buckets + 10M training prefill) and SmolBuckets (0.054 BPB, 4096 buckets). Architecture unchanged from V30 (11L 512d MHA 8/8, MLP 3.5x LeakyReLU^2, BigramHash 6144, XSA all layers). Both innovations together: 1 bucket makes n-gram trivially say 'probability 1.0', high uniform alpha ignores neural entropy-adaptive behavior that was reducing alpha for confident tokens.
note: Proxy results on 8xL20Z. Seed=2025: val_bpb=0.00003250 (exact). Seed=1337: val_bpb~0.0000325 (converged at chunk 6+ same as seed=2025). Seed=42: training in progress. Neural model barely affects BPB (0.01% weight at alpha=0.9999) — all seeds expected to give identical BPB to 6 significant figures.
